title: Arkret Consent Cell Self-Management Operation DTOs
description: Closed request/response DTOs for holder-private consent cells. Only holders/controllers receive consent_cell_view; peer request submission returns an opaque outcome and never exposes cell state.

active_grant_dots.description: Currently-active grant dots (not yet observed/revoked, within validity window).

consent_grant_request_body.description: Carries the caller-signed ak.consent.grant Control Move and nothing else. consent_id, peer, consent_scope, not_before and expires_at all live in grant_event.event.payload; the holder is taken from the path. consent_id is producer-allocated, so the caller mints it: it is the cell subject (ak:cell:ak.component.consent.grant.v1:<consent_id>), and the or_set add dot is 'ak:event:<enclosing event_id>:<write_index>' (zh/identity/consent-model.md section 3.2). A service that wrote this element itself would be putting consent into replicated cell state that no Event in the log explains.

grant_event.description: Closed ak.consent.grant Event whose actor_id and authenticated holder are the path holder Principal Control Realm's current authority-root controller. authorization_ref MUST bind the current authority-root authorization. This root_control_only action supports neither separate managed-behalf execution nor grants: controller/agent consent_write delegations, general PCR writes, co-owner grants, automation, or payload approval evidence do not substitute. The service MUST submit these exact bytes through ordinary Event admission and MUST NOT co-sign, rebuild or synthesize the Event. Admission MUST verify the authority-root binding, event.realm_id, and path holder; otherwise it rejects unauthorized.

consent_revoke_request_body.description: Carries the caller-signed ak.consent.revoke Control Move and nothing else. Its payload.observed_dots MUST enumerate every active dot that becomes inactive, and the caller reads those dots back from consent_cell_view.active_grant_dots: an observe-remove OR-Set revoker has to name the exact dots or two concurrent revokes race, one removing the old dot and the other the new one while the UI reports success (zh/identity/consent-model.md section 3.2). A consent_scope=any cascade is no exception.

revoke_event.description: Closed ak.consent.revoke Event whose actor_id and authenticated holder are the path holder Principal Control Realm's current authority-root controller. authorization_ref MUST bind the current authority-root authorization. This root_control_only action supports neither separate managed-behalf execution nor a controller/agent consent_write delegation or general PCR/co-owner grant. Its payload.consent_id MUST equal the consent_id of the ak.consent.grant being revoked. The service MUST submit these exact bytes through ordinary Event admission and MUST NOT co-sign, rebuild or synthesize the Event.

consent_request_request_body.description: Body for opaque contact/consent request submission. The peer principal is the authenticated actor and is never caller-supplied. Holder existence is deliberately not a precondition visible to the caller.

consent_request_outcome.description: Constant anti-enumeration response. Missing holder, denial, rate-limit drop and quarantine acceptance all return this exact shape; no cell id, state, dots, timestamps or expiry are exposed.
